Container.Name: image-autotagger
Container.Overview: Offline tagging, renaming and organizing for very large art collections. Reads each image with a local ONNX tagger plus a vision model served by Ollama, embeds the tags, caption and title in the file itself (XMP, plus IPTC/EXIF for JPEG/WebP), renames it to something readable, and files it into folders you define by tag in the web UI. Originals are never modified: a tagged copy is written to Output and validated, and only then is the original moved to Complete. Resumable: safe to stop and restart at any time.
Container.Requires: An Ollama endpoint serving a vision model (default qwen3-vl:8b). For keyword tags, put an ONNX tagger (kagami-24k model_prob.onnx renamed to model.onnx, plus selected_tags.csv) in Models/tagger/. Without it, fast tags come from filenames and folders only. Plan about 2x the collection size in free space.
Container.Description: Offline AI tagging, renaming and organizing for large image collections. Tags are embedded in the files.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface port.

Config.Name: Input (drop batches here)
Config.Description: Drop image batches here, sub-folders welcome (folder names become tags). Originals are never written to; they are moved to Complete after their tagged copy validates.

Config.Name: Output (tagged + organized)
Config.Description: Tagged, renamed copies. New files land in _unsorted/ and the organizer moves them into your folders.

Config.Name: Complete (originals)
Config.Description: Originals are moved here, keeping their sub-folders, once the tagged copy is validated.

Config.Name: Errors
Config.Description: Only used when Error handling is 'move'.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: State database (state.sqlite), thumbnail cache, optional config.yaml.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: ONNX tagger weights: tagger/model.onnx + tagger/selected_tags.csv.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Ollama endpoint serving the vision model.

Config.Name: Vision model
Config.Description: Ollama vision model id (qwen3-vl:8b, gemma4:12b, llama3.2-vision:11b, moondream).

Config.Name: Caption pass enabled
Config.Description: false = fast tags only (no caption/title; names come from top tags).

Config.Name: VLM timeout (s)
Config.Description: Per-image request timeout. A timeout is recorded as warn:no_caption and the file keeps its fast tags.

Config.Name: Tagger model path
Config.Description: ONNX tagger file; selected_tags.csv must sit next to it.

Config.Name: Tagger threshold
Config.Description: Keep tagger tags at or above this confidence.

Config.Name: Auto-watch input
Config.Description: Scan Input every 30 s. false = only when you click 'Scan input now'.

Config.Name: Error handling
Config.Description: flag = leave failed originals in Input and list them on the dashboard; move = move them to Errors.

Config.Name: Min free GB
Config.Description: Processing pauses while Output has less free space than this.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Run as this user (99 = nobody) so files on the shares stay accessible over SMB.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Run as this group (100 = users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File-creation mask. 000 keeps tagged copies and moved originals writable by every share user (needed when the share belongs to AD/SMB users rather than nobody:users).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for log timestamps and batch ids.
